name: Ip2_PolyhedraMat_PolyhedraMat_PolyhedraPhys
description: Computes the interaction properties<PolyhedraPhys> from the material properties<PolyhedraMat> of the two interacting bodies 1,2. Contact friction angle is taken as the minimum of the two frictionAngle<PolyhedraMat.frictionAngle>, and contact stiffnesses kn<PolyhedraPhys.kn> and ks<PolyhedraPhys.ks>...
